theme.title: Magic in the air
theme.subtitle: Orlando Magic, 2008–09
theme.recap: Dwight Howard anchored Orlando's defense while its shooters carried the Magic past Boston and Cleveland to the Finals.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Dwight Howard's 2008–09 Magic win?
questions.note: 59 wins under coach Stan Van Gundy.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the team finished the regular season with a 59–23 record

funFacts.text: Dwight Howard became the youngest Defensive Player of the Year winner that spring.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: becoming the youngest player to win the award

funFacts.text: A shoulder injury to All-Star Jameer Nelson forced Orlando to reshape its backcourt.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jameer Nelson left a game after dislocating his right shoulder

questions.prompt: How many three-pointers did Orlando make against Sacramento in January 2009?
questions.note: 23 made threes in a high-scoring win.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

funFacts.text: Nine different Orlando players made at least one three-pointer that night.
